newsitem.title: UK: Israel security man in London to probe bombs-paper.
newsitem.headline: Israel security man in London to probe bombs-paper.

text.p: The head of Israel's internal security service is in London to investigate claims that last month's double suicide bombing in Jerusalem was carried out by Arab guerrillas based in Britain, the Sunday Telegraph newspaper reported.
It said Shin Bet's Ami Ayalon was liaising with agents of MI5, its British counterpart.
Two bombers killed themselves and 14 other people in an attack on a Jewish market in Jerusalem in July. Responsibility was claimed by the Palestinian guerilla group Hamas.
The Telegraph said Ayalon was investigating reports that the suicide bombers entered Israel on British passports and the attack might have been planned by Arabs based in London.
It said Israeli officials found large amounts of Jordanian dinars in the bombers' pockets and believed they received financial aid and training from abroad.
